members.name: tvg_font_load
members.brief: Loads a scalable font data from a file.
description: ThorVG efficiently caches the loaded data using the specified `path` as a key. This means that loading the same file again will not result in duplicate operations; instead, ThorVG will reuse the previously loaded font data.

params.name: path
params.description: The path to the font file.

retvals.description: An invalid `path` passed as an argument.
When trying to load a file with an unknown extension.

members.name: tvg_font_load_data
members.signature: Tvg_Result tvg_font_load_data(const char* name, const char* data, uint32_t size, const char *mimetype, bool copy)
members.brief: Loads a scalable font data from a memory block of a given size.
description: ThorVG efficiently caches the loaded font data using the specified `name` as a key. This means that loading the same fonts again will not result in duplicate operations. Instead, ThorVG will reuse the previously loaded font data.

params.name: name
params.description: The name under which the font will be stored and accessible (e.x. in a `tvg_text_set_font` API).

params.name: data
params.description: A pointer to a memory location where the content of the font data is stored.

params.name: size
params.description: The size in bytes of the memory occupied by the `data`.

params.name: mimetype
params.description: Mimetype or extension of font data. In case a `nullptr` or an empty "" value is provided the loader will be determined automatically.

params.name: copy
params.description: If `true` the data are copied into the engine local buffer, otherwise they are not (default).

retvals.description: If no name is provided or if `size` is zero while `data` points to a valid memory location.
When trying to load a file with an unknown extension.
When trying to unload the font data that has not been previously loaded.

notes: To unload the font data loaded using this API, pass the proper `name` and `nullptr` as `data`.
warnings: : It's the user responsibility to release the `data` memory.

members.name: tvg_font_unload
members.brief: Unloads the specified scalable font data that was previously loaded.
description: This function is used to release resources associated with a font file that has been loaded into memory.

params.name: path
params.description: The path to the loaded font file.

notes: If the font data is currently in use, it will not be immediately unloaded.
